name: alakazam_ml_v23
model: The v20 LightGBM action ranker and its live scope are unchanged. v23 adds a card-ID-agnostic pairwise linear ranker only as a bounded Boss-target tie-break.
model_scope: Hard rules own legality, win, KO, prize tier, Boss use, and all non-target decisions. The v23 target model contributes at most +/-800 inside the deterministic target value.

source_evidence.interpretation: Expert play rejects unconditional ex gusting, but learned target features materially improve same-tier ordering over a naive prize/KO rule. v23 therefore hardens concrete ordinary-single to KO-able-ex upgrades while preserving named engine exceptions.

v23_rule_changes: Explicitly dispatch Boss opponent targeting before generic own-side SWITCH handling.
Add +6000 only to a concrete same-turn multi-prize KO, leaving unreachable ex targets at the v22 value.
Raise Boss over a current ordinary single-prize attack only when Alakazam can KO both routes after the real Boss hand cost.
Never leave an Active winning KO, never assume pre-Boss hand damage, and keep high-role single-prize engines outside the forced upgrade gate.
Use a bounded card-ID-agnostic learned target score as a narrow strategic tie-break.
preserved_v22_invariants: v22 backup ETA and continuity Dudunsparce logic
v22 Dunsparce rebuild and backup pre-attachment
v22 attack-route promotion and shield switching
terminal Boss and terminal Active win gates
Mist Energy Hammer memory and effect-prevention handling
deck floors, exact-KO hand protection, and Fezandipiti exposure gates
known_limitations: A new live ladder rating has not been measured; 900/1000 stability is a goal, not a validated outcome.
Teacher-forced policy comparison does not simulate the counterfactual trajectory after a changed action.
A single expert action is preference data, not proof of globally optimal play.
No official cg package is present locally, so only a source ZIP can be produced.
